name: T800
summary: EngineAI's full-size flagship, named after the Terminator and marketed on athleticism — 450 N·m peak joint torque in a magnesium-aluminum frame. It is one of the first humanoids shipped with a solid-state battery, and EngineAI claims a production line turning out a unit every fifteen minutes with 79 quality checks each.
notable: Among the first humanoids with a solid-state battery
Mass-production line cadence of one unit per 15 minutes
